title: Nick Bosa breaks extended Twitter silence to express agreement with Ryan Clark's ouster

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Nick Bosa breaks extended Twitter silence to express agreement with Ryan Clark's ouster
sources.description: The story of the week came from ESPN, where a supposed exercise in removing red ink became, for NFL analyst Ryan Clark, more like a Red Wedding. 49ers defensive end Nick Bosa has chosen to chime in.
